G Vector.name: G-Vector
G Vector.summary: G Vector is an on-the-rails shoot-'em-up game released exclusively for the Sega Saturn in Japan.

Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special.name: Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special
Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special.summary:
A mahjong game for Saturn and 3DO Interactive Multiplayer.

Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Special is a table game developed and published by Jaleco for the Sega Saturn. It is part of Jaleco's Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai series.

The game had some nudity present in the original version removed for the Saturn version, in order to be rated 18. It was later rereleased as Idol Janshi Suchie-Pai Remix with an X rating and all the original content restored.

Layer Section II.name: RayStorm
Layer Section II.summary: RayStorm is a scrolling shooter set hundreds of years in the future, and was one of the launch titles for the Sony PlayStation. RayStorm consists of eight stages where players must pilot their "R-Gray" spaceships shooting down anything that moves. Like all of the games in the Ray Series, enemies can be shot down with a primary weapon or by holding down a missile button to lock on to multiple enemies.

Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV - Wall.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV: Wall of Fire
Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV - Wall.summary: Romance of the Three Kingdoms IV: Wall of Fire (Sangokushi IV in Japan) is the fourth game in Koei's Romance of the Three Kingdoms series. Wall of Fire was the first game for the Playstation & Saturn consoles and the last in the series to be released on PC in the U.S. until Romance of the Three Kingdoms XI.

Shippuu Mahou Daisakusen - Kingdom-Grand.name: Kingdom Grand Prix
Shippuu Mahou Daisakusen - Kingdom-Grand.summary: Kingdom Grand Prix is a vertically scrolling shooter/racing hybrid arcade game created by Eighting/Raizing, it was later ported to the Sega Saturn. It is the second in the Mahou Daisakusen series, but the first to include the bizarre but original feature of being a shooter/racing hybrid.
